easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to you and Hexhaven Invigorator.
Hexhaven Invigorator triggers, causing you to search your library for an amount of land cards equal to the damage dealt to it and putting them onto the battlefield tapped.
